title: Intent-Aware Operating System — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Interprets high-level user goals and proposes coordinated actions across applications. A proposed operating system that understands intent: the user states a high-level goal, and the OS proposes a coordinated plan of actions across applications — opening, filling, scheduling, sending — then executes only after the user approves. The user stays in command; the OS does the legwork.
capabilities: Interpret high-level user goals
Plan coordinated actions across applications
Propose plans for user approval before acting
Execute approved plans with full logging
Learn user preferences for future proposals
